meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 当你让它规划功能或任务时,它会先搜集相关文档与代码证据,再产出分阶段实施计划:每阶段写明要做什么、参考哪份文档、如何验证,并提醒别用文档里不存在的接口。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一个功能、任务或多步骤实施时,尤其是用 do 执行之前。

say.text: 帮我规划一个登录功能,先查一下现有代码里怎么写的。
say.note: 会先做文档调研,再给分阶段计划。

say.text: 为这个重构任务做一份分阶段计划,每步给出验证清单。
say.note: 每阶段会带文档引用和验证项。

say.text: 先别写代码,先做文档调研再给我实施计划。
say.note: 计划会基于文档证据而非猜测。

howto.what_en: When asked to plan a feature or task, Claude gathers doc/code evidence first, then outputs a phased implementation plan: each phase states what to build, which doc lines to follow, how to verify, and anti-patterns to avoid.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before running do.

say_en.text: Plan a login feature; first check how the existing code does it.
Make a phased plan for this refactor, with a verification checklist per step.
say_en.note: Each phase includes doc refs and checks.

say_en.text: Don't write code yet—do doc research first, then give the plan.
